description: Welcome to this newly updated 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath home in the heart of Riverside! Tucked at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac and sitting on a spacious 8,712 sq ft lot, this single-story home offers a functional layout paired with a long list of tasteful upgrades throughout. Step inside to find brand new vinyl flooring, fresh interior and exterior paint, recessed lighting, and new ceiling fans that create a bright, modern feel. The fully remodeled kitchen features new shaker cabinetry, quarts countertops, a tile backsplash, and brand new stainless steel appliances, designed for both everyday living and entertaining. Both bathrooms have been upgraded with new vanities, toilets, and beautifully finished tile showers. Additional improvements include dual-pane windows and updated lighting fixtures. The exterior showcases a newly landscaped front yard, a 2-car attached garage, and potential RV access, while the backyard offers a true blank canvas with ample space to design your dream outdoor retreat, add a pool, or explore ADU potential. Conveniently located near California Baptist University, local parks, shopping, dining, and with easy access to the 91 freeway, this move-in-ready home is a fantastic opportunity in a desirable Riverside neighborhood.
